description: $0.01 USDC on Solana per lookup - Your payment includes one composite lookup for the topic you submit: one answer section per requested leg (provider, class H1, licence, attribution, that leg's freshness, and its load state printed on every section), the matching entries from each loaded leg, the per-leg factors, and the A1 absence statement. Legs are never merged and no composite score or merged ranking is included. It does not include any agent-issued search-query data (class A1 — none is published by anyone), any Radar API data (barred, CC BY-NC), any verbatim WildChat prompts, or retention of your submitted topic (it is discarded; only its hash is kept).

legs.description: Leg ids to include; defaults to all cleared legs.

question_class.description: Optional question class for the lookup.

topic.description: The topic to look up in each requested leg.

name: composite_inventory_lookup
